'''''Velker''''' was the name of a type of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] used by the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]].

==Characteristics==
From the front, the ''Velker'' had a thin cross-section, as it was essentially one long wing. The fighter was equipped with three engines, four [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], and required a single [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].

==History==
The pirate [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] acquired several of these fighters for his band, the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]]. They flew as his wingmates during multiple skirmishes including a [[Battle of Lok (32 BBY)|raid on Lok]].

==Behind the scenes==
This fighter appeared in [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']] as an NPC ally character.
